resources.string: Shows the Buddy chat bubble and lets the agent you choose (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Antigravity or Grok), running inside Buddy on this phone, read the screen and tap, type and scroll for you. Nothing leaves the phone except what the agent itself sends to its AI service (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, xAI or your OpenCode model\'s provider).

Buddy uses Android\'s accessibility service to do what you ask in other apps: it reads what\'s on the screen and taps, types and scrolls for you. It also shows the floating bubble.

While a task runs, the screen content, which can include personal information such as messages, names or addresses, is sent to the AI service of the agent you choose (Anthropic for Claude Code, OpenAI for Codex, Google for Antigravity, xAI for Grok, or your OpenCode model\'s provider), only to carry out your request.
Buddy has no servers of its own. It doesn\'t collect, sell or share this data, and doesn\'t use it for ads.
Before anything that sends, posts, buys or deletes, Buddy asks for your OK. You can turn the service off anytime in Android\'s accessibility settings.

A temporary session per tap, without tools: it sees your request, the agent\'s note and the screen, and says allow, ask you, or advise against. About 3 seconds a tap. OpenCode, Antigravity and Grok chats are reviewed by Claude Code (or Codex).
It also checks replies before a notification rule\'s countdown sends them.
